title: ProtVista feature record
description: The feature record your own CSV, TSV, JSON or BED file decodes to, and the feature tracks consume. CSV/TSV/JSON records keep every extra column or key (for dataTooltip) except tooltipContent, locations, residuesToHighlight and Object.prototype names; BED records carry only the canonical fields. Generic format only — domain-adapter (EBI API) payloads are not schematised. See docs/adapter-reference.md.

type.description: Feature category label (e.g. DOMAIN, BINDING). Drives `filter:` and colour grouping.

start.$comment: JSON sources also accept `begin` as an alias for `start`; `start` wins when both are present.

end.description: 1-based end position (inclusive). Must not be less than `start`.

description.description: Free text shown in the default tooltip. CSV/TSV: the `description` header column is required (its cells may be empty); optional in JSON, and BED reads it from the `name` column. Omitted when empty.

score.description: Optional numeric score. Omitted when empty.

color.description: Per-feature colour (any CSS colour) for the outline, and the fill unless `fill` is set; wins over the track's `rendering.color`. CSV/TSV/JSON only — BED never sets it. Omitted when empty.

shape.description: Per-feature glyph (see the type and shape vocabulary); wins over the track's `rendering.shape`. CSV/TSV/JSON only. Omitted when empty, and dropped with a warning when it names an Object.prototype property (`valueOf`, `constructor`, …).

fill.description: Per-feature fill colour; defaults to `color`. CSV/TSV/JSON only. Omitted when empty.

opacity.description: Per-feature opacity, from 0 to 1 (the canvas default is 0.9). CSV/TSV/JSON only. Omitted when empty; any other value is an error.
